composition: One shop at full size beside the headline, with the other five as a strip below.
prompt:
A desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT at 16:9: the home page of "biznes.mu", a Mauritian website that sells finished, ready-to-open businesses. It is a designed web page interface, not a poster and not a photograph.

LAYOUT:
1. NAVIGATION BAR, thin, full width, on a deep cobalt dusk-blue ground: at the far left the wordmark "biznes.mu" in white sans with a tiny saffron-yellow shopfront glyph before it; at the far right two white text links "Businesses" and "How it works", then one saffron-yellow pill button with dark text "Enquire".
2. HERO, two halves on the cobalt dusk ground. LEFT HALF: a headline in very large condensed bold sign-painter CAPITALS, white with a hard offset coral drop shade, on two lines: "BUY A BUSINESS" then "READY TO OPEN". Under it a short paragraph in a clean white sans: "In Mauritius, built by Khay Digital. The name, the brand, the domain, the website and the strategy are done. Each business is sold once, to one owner." Under that one saffron-yellow pill button with dark text "See the businesses" and beside it a white text link "How it works" with a small arrow.
RIGHT HALF: ONE large shopfront seen FRONT-ON, filling the right half from the navigation bar almost to the bottom: a small single-storey Mauritian shop with a corrugated tin roof and a white scalloped lambrequin fringe, a deep bordeaux painted facade, a big hand-painted sign board reading exactly "LePalatier" in ivory classical serif lit by two brass lamps, a CLOSED ribbed roller shutter, a brass-coloured door frame, and beside the door a blue enamel street plaque with white capitals "MOKA  GRAND BAIE  TAMARIN". A small white swing tag hangs from the shutter handle reading "No. 01  Available".
3. BOTTOM STRIP, full width, low and small: the other five shopfronts as a row of small front-on shops, shutters closed, each a different saturated colour with its sign reading in order "lakrem", "SOUFFLE", "Bouké", "LAROUT", "kazprop", each with a small white tag reading "Sample".

STYLE: clean stylised low-poly 3D diorama with crisp geometry, deep cobalt blue-hour sky, warm glowing sign lamps, dark pavement; saturated tropical paint colours (saffron, turquoise, coral, bordeaux, teal); crisp modern interface typography. No people, no cars, no other text, no other logos, no watermark.
